input.title: Test: Concurrent moves
input.body:
Add a test for the following concurrent editing scenario. Run the test 10 times to flush out race conditions. 

## Steps to Reproduce

``` 
- a
- b
- c
``` 

Client A: Move `c` into `a`
Client B: Move `c` into `b`

## Expected Behavior

``` 
- a
  - c
- b
```

Or:

``` 
- a
- b
  - c
``` 

## Assertions
 
Make sure the Thoughts and Lexemes are updated properly.
